doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Designating a Business as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-09-14 to designate Prime Melwa (Private) Limited as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance, under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act,                  No.11 of 2021. Accordingly, an Order has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2507/47 dated 2026-09-23, designating Prime Melwa (Private) Limited as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance, enabling to grant the relevant tax exemptions and incentives. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to present the said Order in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
